Spice is back on Bird Patrol!
Do you need a blep? Because Smudge has a blep, just for you.
"I'm not playing peek-a-boo, I just don't want to look at you."

The Scamperbeasts have been sent very potent catnip bananas from some admirers, and as they will shred the fabric of those bananas in minutes, one of the humans helpfully cut open a banana and put the catnip inside some rather more durable old socks. All the Scamperbeasts are SUPER high right now.
Smudge steps up in his editorial capacity to make sure the human gets work done on his computer today
Spice the cat, clearly thrilled to be on Bluesky and that the Scamperbeasts already have over a thousand followers. Thanks, folks!

Also, for those curious, here are a couple of the earliest pictures of the three Scamperbeasts when they arrived in 2015 (Sugar, Spice) and 2018 (Smudge). Sugar and Spice were part of a neighbor's litter; Smudge just plain showed up at the house.
Welcome to the first post of the Scamperbeasts' Bluesky account. It shows Smudge in his natural habitat. Follow for cat-related naps, chaos and hijinx.
